annotations.anchor_text: The EPP is always in effect. The plans and operational procedures within the EPP are executed on an as-needed basis as determined by the Administrator or highest-ranking member of the leadership team onsite at the time of the event (Incident Commander).

annotations.instruction_text: Revise to reflect proper care level
annotations.anchor_text: The HVA provides a systematic approach to recognizing hazards that may affect demand for nursing homes or assisted living residences or the ability to provide those services. The risks associated with each hazard are analyzed to prioritize planning, mitigation, response, and recovery activities. The HVA serves as a needs assessment for the Emergency Preparedness Program. This process involves facility staff representing the safety and/or emergency management committee and community partners (area emergency managers, fire and police departments, and emergency management services).

annotations.instruction_text: Revise if your planned shelter in place time is less
annotations.anchor_text: The disaster or emergency may exceed the facility’s capabilities, and external resources and assets may not be available from vendors or others. The facility is prepared to be self-sustaining for a minimum of 96 hours or longer without outside assistance if conditions allow for safe sheltering in place.
